cases.name: jsdoc/parsed
cases.rationale: C# keeps the template parameter list at its source range [56,57), while Go stores [0,0). The return-description text and its list exclude one leading trivia byte in C# ([87,96) versus [86,96)). Kinds, concatenated text, child topology, and all remaining node fields match.
cases.independentControl: The pinned Go encoder produces the exact C# packet from the complete candidate syntax and source metadata.

cases.name: jsdoc-typedef/parsed
cases.rationale: C# omits three empty documentation-description lists and retains trailing whitespace in typedef/tag and synthesized host ranges (end 90 versus 87). A synthesized numeric annotation retains the C# parser context flags. The changed child-mask and index links follow the empty-list difference; tag/type/name/literal content and nonempty child topology are preserved.
cases.independentControl: The pinned Go encoder produces the exact C# packet from the complete candidate syntax and source metadata.
